data.one_liner: A comprehensive OTP verification package with SMS autofill, biometric integration, and custom animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides fully customizable OTP and verification code input fields supporting SMS autofill, custom field shapes, animations, rate limiting, and biometric integration.
use_when: You need a feature-rich OTP code entry screen with SMS autofill.
You require advanced error handling, animations, and security configurations for verification inputs.
avoid_when: You only need a basic single text input field without dedicated PIN digit segmentation.
strengths: Extensive customization options for shapes, cursors, and animations
Built-in SMS autofill and biometric security features
Comprehensive error handling and rate-limiting support
weaknesses: May be overly heavy or complex if you only require a simple standalone PIN view
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific configuration for SMS retrieval APIs on Android if SMS autofill is used.
